source_lock.rule: Each of the 168 source-locked api_surface endpoints has exactly one covered_by projection; the listed artifacts are the non-duplicated operation manifest.

binary_read.evidence: The recovered published contract has only JSON REST resource endpoints. Attachment resource CRUD is not a documented binary transfer operation.

binary_write.evidence: The recovered published contract has no documented upload or other binary transfer endpoint; no REST write is recast as binary.

direct_read.evidence: One operation-backed get command per Twenty object with exact REST path and json_redacted output policy.

direct_write.evidence: The recovered published REST mutations are schema-backed typed reverse-ETL actions, not direct-write operation contracts.

reverse_etl.safety: Every action uses plan, preview, approval, and execute; all 28 delete actions retain typed destructive confirmation.

typed_destination.boundary: The adapter cannot transport tombstones; this limits transport execution only. It does not remove, disable, or reclassify typed delete CLI commands.
typed_destination.application_dispatch: Not deployable until the refreshed #4304 foundation proves persisted App/CLI dispatch selects declarative_typed_destination.

executable_cli.evidence: TestAllProviderOperationsHaveExecutableCommands runs the actual commandrunner preflight for every command; connectorgen surface-sync verifies endpoint ownership.

reconciliation.verification_contract: connector-local red/green destination declaration test; connectorgen validation and surface sync; refreshed #4304 ancestor proof plus installed App/CLI dispatch; certification checks; connector boundary; built-binary read/write/delete proof.
